keywords: ACDE #233 把 EIP-8141 frame 交易列为 Hegotá 的 CFI 非头号提案
EIP-8141 原子批处理与内存池策略合并
summary: ACDE #233 决定 Hegotá 不设执行层头号提案，把 EIP-8141 frame 交易列为非头号的 Considered for Inclusion。同日 derekchiang 的原子批处理与 lightclient 的内存池策略两项 EIP-8141 更新合并。Glamsterdam 方面，bal-devnet-3 与 epbs-devnet-1 计划下周上线。EF 协议团队发布 EIP Champion 手册。

keywords_en: ACDE #233 makes EIP-8141 frame transactions Considered for Inclusion in Hegotá as a non headliner
EIP-8141 atomic batching and mempool policy merged
summary_en: ACDE #233 decided Hegotá will have no execution layer headliner and made EIP-8141 frame transactions Considered for Inclusion as a non headliner. The same day, derekchiang's atomic batching and lightclient's mempool policy updates to EIP-8141 merged. For Glamsterdam, bal-devnet-3 and epbs-devnet-1 are planned for next week. The EF protocol team published an EIP Champion's Handbook.
